name: D-Class Dormitory
description: A large, sterile dormitory shared by eight D-Class personnel. Rows of metallic bunk beds are bolted to the floor. The air is thick with the smell of sweat and recycled oxygen. A heavy, reinforced door with a high-clearance keypad is the only way out.

bunk_beds.description: Spartan bunk beds with thin, gray mattresses. Most are occupied by huddled figures. Tucked under one of the lower mattresses, you feel something hard and plastic.

security_keypad.description: A modern biometric and card-based keypad. It glows with a forbidding red light. Level 3 clearance required.

name: Storage Nook
description: A small dead end with some empty crates.

name: Utility Closet
description: A cramped closet containing cleaning supplies.

name: Observation Deck
description: A small platform overlooking a dark maintenance shaft.

name: Sterile Hallway
description: A long, sterile hallway stretching to the north and south.

name: Sterile Hallway
description: A long, sterile hallway stretching to the east and west.

name: Hallway Corner
description: The hallway turns here, leading north and east.

name: Hallway Corner
description: The hallway turns here, leading north and west.

name: Hallway Corner
description: The hallway turns here, leading south and east.

name: Hallway Corner
description: The hallway turns here, leading south and west.

name: T-Junction
description: A three-way junction leading north, east, and west.

name: T-Junction
description: A three-way junction leading south, east, and west.

name: T-Junction
description: A three-way junction leading north, south, and east.

name: T-Junction
description: A three-way junction leading north, south, and west.

name: Main Intersection
description: A major crossroads with hallways leading in all four directions.

name: Security Checkpoint
description: A fortified checkpoint with reinforced glass and a monitoring station. A Level 2 keycard is sitting on the desk.

desk.description: A heavy metal desk with several monitors showing static.

name: Dimly Lit Hallway
description: The lights flicker overhead in this long, north-south hallway. Scrape marks are visible on the floor.

name: Sub-Control Room
description: A cramped room filled with server racks and diagnostic terminals.

name: Containment Suite Lobby
description: A small, sterile entrance area leading to a specific containment unit. A heavy blast door is to the north, and a reinforced glass window looks into a room to the east.

name: Observation Room
description: A room filled with monitoring equipment and recording devices. A large pane of ballistic glass provides a view of the containment chamber.

monitors.description: Dozens of screens showing various telemetry and a live video feed of the chamber.

name: Containment Chamber
description: A heavily reinforced chamber designed to hold anomalous entities. The walls are lined with specialized alloys.

name: Vacant Office
description: A small, tidy office. A single desk sits in the corner. The computer terminal is dark.

desk.description: A standard office desk. The drawers are empty.

terminal.description: The computer terminal is offline. A sticky note on the monitor has 'skill_basic_lockpicking' written on it.
